name: Datanla Falls
summary: Walk down to Datanla Falls on Prenn Pass, or ride the alpine coaster or go canyoning with a guide for a faster way to the water. Allow at least an hour, and buy the plain entrance if the falls are all you want.

notice.title: The entrance is not the coaster
notice.body: The plain entrance does not include the alpine coaster or canyoning. Ask which ticket you are buying.

body: Datanla is the waterfall on Prenn Pass, south of town. The walk to the cascade is the visit. Canyoning with a guide and the alpine coaster are the add-ons.
Allow about an hour for the falls alone. If you only wanted the falls, buy the plain entrance; the coaster and canyoning are sold as higher bundles.

figures.caption: The cascade at Datanla
figures.alt: Water falling at Datanla Falls on Prenn Pass

gettingThere: The falls are on Prenn Pass, south of the centre. Take a taxi from Xuan Huong Lake.
admissionNote: 30,000 VND entrance (Visit Lâm Đồng). Operator pages sell higher bundles with the coaster or canyoning. Confirm at the gate.
